documents.population: First-year applicants; international applicants follow the same process
documents.notes: 'Application Requirements' (first-year) and 'International Applicants' FAQ. The final transcript is due in June if accepted and enrolling. The first-year page announces the application for fall 2027 entry, but the requirements page states no academic year for the list; it is recorded as standing policy.

items.quote: Penn accepts applications from the Common App and Coalition Application.
your personal statement, which is sent to most schools
You will need to request that an official transcript is sent by a school counselor or another school official for all high schools you have attended.
Your counselor or another school official will need to send a Counselor Recommendation on your behalf.
You will also need to request a recommendation letter from a teacher.

Penn-Specific Essays and Short Answers Who Submits This: You! Due: November 1 for Early Decision, January 5 for Regular Decision When answering these prompts, be precise when explaining both why you are applying to Penn and why you have chosen to apply to a specific undergraduate school.
Penn applicants are required to submit the SAT or ACT.

You are exempt from submitting an English proficiency test score if either of the following is true: English is your native language, or English was your primary language of instruction for at least three years (in high school, college, or a combination of both) by the time you enroll at Penn. If neither applies to you, you must submit scores from one of the following tests: TOEFL IELTS Academic Duolingo English Test
items.condition: English is not your native language and was not your primary language of instruction for at least three years by enrolment

items.quote: Yes, please ensure that we receive a certified translations of any of your application materials which are not originally printed in English.
